create_unit_tokenizer: create a UnitTokenizer with num_units, supported languages, and model architecture type
create_encoder: create a UnitTokenEncoder for a specified language to encode speech units into token indices
create_decoder: create a UnitTokenDecoder to decode token indices back into speech units
encode_units: encode speech unit tensors into token indices with language prefix and control symbol offset
decode_tokens: decode token index tensors back into speech units by removing prefixes and control symbol offsets
